Link Quality Settings Enable Link Quality Management

aredn.@lqm[0].enable OFFON
Maximum packet size in bytes sent over WiFi (256 to 1500)

aredn.@lqm[0].mtu
WAN Settings Allow other MESH nodes to use my WAN - not recommended and OFF by default

aredn.@wan[0].olsrd_gw OFFON
Allow my LAN devices to access my WAN - ON by default

aredn.@wan[0].lan_dhcp_route OFFON
Provide default route to LAN devices even when WAN access is disabled

aredn.@wan[0].lan_dhcp_defaultroute OFFON
WAN VLAN Number - must be an integer in the range [1,4094]

aredn.wan.vlanid
Enable web access to the node from the WAN interface

aredn.@wan[0].web_access OFFON
Enable SSH access to the node from the WAN interface

aredn.@wan[0].ssh_access OFFON
Enable TELNET access to the node from the WAN interface

aredn.@wan[0].telnet_access OFFON
Power Options PoE Passthrough specifies whether PoE power should be enabled (Not all devices have PoE passthrough ports)

aredn.@poe[0].passthrough OFFON
Tunnel Options Tunnel Maxclients specifies the maximum number of tunnel clients this node can serve; must be an integer in the range [0,100].

aredn.@tunnel[0].maxclients
Tunnel Maxservers specifies the maximum number of tunnel servers to which this node can connect; must be an integer in the range [0,100].

aredn.@tunnel[0].maxservers
WAN-Only Tunnel prevents tunnel traffic from being routed over the Mesh network itself

aredn.@tunnel[0].wanonly OFFON
Memory Settings Low Memory Threshold in KB when the Mesh Status page will be truncated

aredn.@meshstatus[0].lowmem
Low Memory Max Routes is the maximum number of routes shown on the Mesh Status page when low memory is detected

aredn.@meshstatus[0].lowroutes
Network Tools OLSR Restart will restart OLSR when executed; wait up to 2 or 3 minutes to receive response

aredn.olsr.restart Click EXECUTE button to trigger this action IPERF Enable allows the included iperf3 client/server

aredn.@iperf[0].enable OFFON
Map Paths Map Tiles URL

aredn.@map[0].maptiles
Leaflet.css URL

aredn.@map[0].leafletcss
Leaflet.js URL

aredn.@map[0].leafletjs
Firmware Firmware Download URL

aredn.@downloads[0].firmwarepath
Core Packages Download URL

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_core
Base Packages URL

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_base
AREDN Packages URL

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_arednpackages
Luci Packages URL

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_luci
Package Download URL for packages not included in the other sections

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_packages
Routing Packages URL

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_routing
Telephony Packages URL

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_telephony
Freifunk Packages URL

aredn.@downloads[0].pkgs_freifunk
Dangerous Upgrade Disables all safety checks usually applied when upgrading firmware

aredn.firmware.dangerous_upgrade OFFON
AREDN Alert Settings Alert Message Refresh - Execute to pull any AREDN Alert messages

aredn.aam.refresh Click EXECUTE button to trigger this action Alert Message Local URL - location from which local AREDN Alerts can be downloaded

aredn.@alerts[0].localpath
Alert Message Groups - comma seperated list of group names to check for alert messages

aredn.@alerts[0].groups
Alert Message Pollrate - how many hours to wait between polling for new AREDN Alerts

aredn.@alerts[0].pollrate
Alert Message Purge - execute to immediately delete all alerts from this node

aredn.aam.purge Click EXECUTE button to trigger this action
